1.1 This standard ( Part 7 ) specifies the requirements for epoxide woven glass fabric copper-clad laminated sheet of defined flammability ( vertical burning test ) for use in printed wiring in telecommunication and allied electronic equipment.
2. TERMINOLOGY

2.1 For the purpose of this standard, the terms in IS : 1885 ( Part 6 )-1978* shall apply.

5. TESTS

5.1 The provisions of 4 of IS : 5921 ( Part 1 )-1983: shall apply -except as modified by 5.1.1. The methods of tests shall be as described in IS : 5921 ( Part 1 )-1983:.
5.1.1 Acceptance Tests In addition to the tests -specified in 4.1.2 of IS : 5921 ( Part 1 )-1983$, flammability test shall also be carried out as acceptance test. Sampling plans and acceptance levels may be agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.

7. ;gb$LECTRICAL

7.1 Surface Finish of the Copper-Clad Face
7.1.1 The copper-cladface shall be free from blisters, wrinkles, pinholes, Any discolouration or contamination deep scratches, pits and resin. shall be readily removed with a hydrochloric acid solution of density 1.02 g/cm3 or with a suitable organic solvent. The surface shall be with 6.2 of IS : 5921 ( Part 1 )-1983*. The inspected in accordance surface finish of the copper-clad face shall be such as not to conceal imperfections. 7.1.2 The surface of the copper foil shall be free from scratches of depth greater than 0.010 mm or l/5 of the nominal thickness of the copper foil, whichever is the lower. 7.1.3 The total length of scratches of depth greater than 0'005 mm but not greater than 0'010 mm shall not exceed 1 m per square metre of the total area of the sheet under test. 7.1.4 The area of' any one or number of pinholes in an area of 0.5 rnz shall not exceed the area of a circle of diameter 0.125 mm. 7.1.5 No sheet shall have those permitted by Table 2. 7.2 Thickness more imperfections of the types listed than

7.2.1 The thickness of~a sheet, including the metal foil, shall not depart at any point from the nominal thickness by more than the appropriate value below:
